_comment: OpenCode Zen gateway. One credential reaches four wires. Exact catalog protocol hints override inferred family defaults; unfamiliar families use Chat Completions. Models are available unless an exact evidenced exception says otherwise, independent of a free suffix. Messages carries images and PDFs with prompt-cache breakpoints and sends only temperature when a request carries temperature and top_p (Claude Haiku 4.5 rejected both, live 2026-10-03); Chat Completions and Responses carry images only (Zen's converters establish no native document, audio or video forwarding there). Responses is stateless (store false) and takes only max_output_tokens and top_p. Gemini generateContent carries Gemini's inline media up to Zen's documented 20 MB request body and reasons at thinkingLevel; none asks for the lowest level.

family_defaults.note: Infer Responses for new versions of the gateway's existing GPT, Grok and Muse families; exact catalog protocol hints win.

New Zen GPT versions inherit the latest verified GPT6.1 effort controls when the catalog gives no ladder. This does not inherit GPT6.1's replay exception. Older Models keep their established off rendering below.
Infer Messages for Claude and Qwen when the catalog is silent. Qwen3.8 Max retains its exact Chat correction.
New Zen Claude versions inherit the current Claude5.5 effort ladder when the catalog reports none; earlier budget controls retain their established fallback below.
Infer native Gemini and the current Gemini4 Argon effort ladder for new versions. Exact catalog protocol and ladder facts win.
New Zen Muse versions inherit the current Muse Spark1.3 effort ladder when the catalog reports none.
New Zen DeepSeek and GLM versions inherit the current V4.1 Flash and GLM5.3 effort ladder. This keeps Zen's effort-only control; no Go thinking switch is inferred.
New Zen Kimi versions inherit the current K3 max-only effort ladder. Earlier K2 Models retain their established fallback below; Go's distinct controls are not copied.

New Zen Mistral Large versions inherit Large4's none/high effort ladder and native-state-only replay, verified 2026-10-14. Catalog support and ladder facts win; another protocol suppresses these Chat defaults.

New Zen Qwen Max versions inherit the latest 3.8 Max Chat route and binary thinking switch. A catalog Messages hint wins and suppresses these Chat defaults; older 3.7 Max keeps its established Messages route below.

rules.note: Preserve the earlier Zen GLM and Kimi Models' established fallback where their catalog supplies no effort ladder; later versions inherit the current family ladder.
Preserve the fallback used by these earlier Zen Claude budget controls; current Claude generations start at low.
Preserve existing Zen GPT off requests: Models with a reported none rung disable reasoning; the others omit the control. New versions inherit the current GPT6.1 minimum-effort behavior.
Zen's earlier Qwen3.7 Max uses Messages, unlike the current Qwen Max generation (official endpoint table read 2026-10-15).

Zen forwards Messages to Anthropic, where these adaptive-only Models reject thinking type disabled (resources/wire/anthropic.json), so effort none sends no thinking field.

Zen forwards Messages to Anthropic, where Claude Haiku 5.5 removed sampling parameters (catalog supports_temperature false in resources/wire/anthropic.json); temperature answers HTTP 400 "`temperature` is deprecated for this model" (live 2026-10-08), so they are never sent.
These Models always reason; none asks for the cheapest rung, low (GPT 6.1 Sol verified 2026-10-02, Space Bunny 2026-09-24).
GPT 6.1 Sol ignores historical Reasoning (verified 2026-10-02), so none is replayed.
